CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #2
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Destroy trees without planting

2. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

3. Which response best shows understanding of The Holy Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Say The Holy Bible has no place in daily life.
   B. Use The Holy Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of The Holy Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Holy Bible.

4. Which response best shows understanding of The Sinai Covenant? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The Sinai Covenant with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say The Sinai Covenant has no place in daily life.
   C. Use The Sinai Covenant to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Sinai Covenant.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Redemption after the Fall of Man? (1 mark)
   A. Say Redemption after the Fall of Man has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Redemption after the Fall of Man to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Redemption after the Fall of Man.
   D. Apply the teaching of Redemption after the Fall of Man with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. Which response best shows understanding of The Exodus? (1 mark)
   A. Use The Exodus to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of The Exodus with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Exodus.
   D. Say The Exodus has no place in daily life.

7. Which response best shows understanding of The New Testament Books? (1 mark)
   A. Use The New Testament Books to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of The New Testament Books with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say The New Testament Books has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The New Testament Books.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Teachings of Prophet Amos? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Teachings of Prophet Amos with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Teachings of Prophet Amos to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Teachings of Prophet Amos has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Teachings of Prophet Amos.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Background of Prophet Amos? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Background of Prophet Amos.
   B. Use Background of Prophet Amos to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Background of Prophet Amos has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Background of Prophet Amos with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Spreading rumours

11. Which response best shows understanding of The New Testament Books 2.2 Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ 2.3 Galilean ? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The New Testament Books 2.2 Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ 2.3 Galilean .
   B. Use The New Testament Books 2.2 Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ 2.3 Galilean  to insult classmates of other faiths.

   D. Apply the teaching of The New Testament Books 2.2 Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ 2.3 Galilean  with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Stewardship Over Creation? (1 mark)
   A. Use Stewardship Over Creation to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Stewardship Over Creation.
   C. Apply the teaching of Stewardship Over Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Stewardship Over Creation has no place in daily life.

13. Which response best shows understanding of Loyalty to God? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Loyalty to God.
   B. Apply the teaching of Loyalty to God with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Loyalty to God has no place in daily life.

14. Which response best shows understanding of The Old Testament Prophets? (1 mark)

15. Which response best shows understanding of Methods of Studying the Holy Bible o Inductive o Devotional o Biographical o Top? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Methods of Studying the Holy Bible o Inductive o Devotional o Biographical o Top with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Methods of Studying the Holy Bible o Inductive o Devotional o Biographical o Top.
   C. Say Methods of Studying the Holy Bible o Inductive o Devotional o Biographical o Top has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Methods of Studying the Holy Bible o Inductive o Devotional o Biographical o Top to insult classmates of other faiths.

----
